about: Gujarat Intrux Ltd is a Rajkot-based manufacturer of stainless-steel, alloy-steel and non-alloy-steel sand castings, operating an integrated foundry and machine shop at Shapar, Gujarat. The business primarily serves valve applications, alongside pumps, earth-moving equipment, oil & gas instrumentation and general engineering, with both domestic and export sales. [1] [2]
